import asyncio

async def act(page):
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for page to load after previous actions
    # Look for project links that contain 'facebook' in their name (case-insensitive)
    projects = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='facebook')
    count = await projects.count()
    forked_count = 0
    if count > 0:
        for i in range(count):
            project = projects.nth(i)
            await project.click()
            # Wait for the project page to load
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
            # Look for the fork button and click it
            fork_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Fork')
            if await fork_button.count() > 0:
                await fork_button.click()
                # Wait for the fork action to complete
                await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
                forked_count += 1
            # Navigate back to the explore page
            await page.go_back()
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # After processing, set terminate_with_result to the count of forked repos
    return str(forked_count)
